entities.summary: Arturo Fernando Zaldívar Lelo de Larrea is a Mexican lawyer who served as a member of the Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation from 2009 to 2023. Zaldívar served as president of the Court from 2 January 2019 to 31 December 2022.
